# The Lean Startup

> A comprehensive resource for understanding and applying lean methodology to product development, entrepreneurship, and startup management through Eric Ries's transformative framework.

The Lean Startup is the official hub for Eric Ries's lean startup methodology, which emphasizes validated learning, rapid iteration, and uncertainty elimination in building new products. The site provides access to the foundational book, related publications in the Lean Series, real-world case studies, and media coverage demonstrating how companies like IMVU and Dropbox have applied these principles.

## Key Topics

- Lean Startup Methodology
- Eric Ries
- Validated Learning
- MVP Testing
- Product Iteration
- Continuous Innovation
- Startup Management
- Entrepreneurship
- Uncertainty Elimination
- Product Development
- Case Studies
- Early Adopters
- Business Strategy
- Startup Examples
- IMVU

## Core Methodology

- [The Lean Startup | Methodology](https://theleanstartup.com/principles): Core Lean Startup methodology and principles by Eric Ries
- [The Lean Startup | The Movement That Is Transforming How New Products Are Built And Launched](https://theleanstartup.com/book): Official Lean Startup book by Eric Ries with purchase links

## Learning & Resources

- [The Lean Startup | The Movement That Is Transforming How New Products Are Built And Launched](https://theleanstartup.com/the-lean-series): Lean Series book collection including Lean Analytics and Lean UX
- [The Lean Startup | Case Studies](https://theleanstartup.com/casestudies): Real-world case studies including Dropbox and Wealthfront examples

## Media & Coverage

- [The Lean Startup | Press](https://theleanstartup.com/press): Press coverage and media mentions from TechCrunch, Fast Company
